day_local: UMvulo weVeki yeShamashumi amabini anesithandathu ngexesha eliqhelekileyo
greeting: Egameni likaYise, neloNyana, neloMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lweNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu kuni nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, usivele imfesane. Kristu, usivele imfesane. Nkosi, usivele imfesane.
psalm_response: Thobela indlebe yakho kum, Nkosi, uve ilizwi lam.
homily:
Kukho umfanekiso oza engqondweni namhlanje, mhlawumbi ngumfanekiso onokuthi uwubone ekhaya. Cinga ngesandla somntwana esincinci, esiphakamileyo, esizama ukubamba into enkulu kakhulu. UBenjamin Vo wayengumfana owayethanda ukubamba izinto—hayi nje iithoyi okanye iikhowudi zekhompyutha azibhalayo, kodwa wayethanda ukubamba ubomi ngokwabo. Wayengumfana owayejonga phezulu, ebuka iindiza ezinkulu, ecinga ngendlela 'i-con chim airlines' yakhe eya kubhabha ngayo. Wayengumfana owayenentliziyo evulekileyo, intliziyo eyayikwazi ukunikela ngayo yonke into, njengaxa wayefuna ukunika umalume wakhe uWilliam imali yakhe yonke yasebhange ngenxa yokuba wayemthanda. 

Kodwa namhlanje, sifunda ngendoda egama linguYobhi. UYobhi wayengumntu olungileyo, owoyika uThixo, owayephila ubomi obumsulwa. Kodwa ngomhla omnye, yonke into yatshintsha. Imithwalo yakhe, abantwana bakhe, impilo yakhe—konke kwathathwa. UYobhi wahlala phantsi, wazikrazula ingubo yakhe, wazicheba intloko, wawa phantsi wathi: 'Ndiyeza ndize ze esizalweni sikamama, ndiya kubuyela ndize ze apho. INkosi yanika, iNkosi yathatha; malibongwe igama leNkosi.' La ngamazwi anzima. La ngamazwi anokuziva ngathi ayayicima intlungu yethu, kodwa anika inyaniso enzulu. UThixo akasigwebi ngezinto ezingaphandle kolawulo lwethu. UThixo akathumeli ukugula okanye iintlekele. Ezinye izinto zenzeka ngaphandle kokuba nabani na enze impazamo. 

Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba sele kuphele iinyanga ezintathu uBen esishiye. Ndiyazi ukuba kukho amaxesha apho intliziyo yakho iziva ngathi iyaphuka. Xa ucinga ngaloo mntwana owayeza kuwe, owayekuthanda, owayekujonga ngamehlo anothando—akukho xesha lonyaka linokuzisa ukuthula ngokukhawuleza. Usizi alulandeli ikhalenda. Luza ngexesha lalo, lunzima, lufuna indawo. Ndaye ndifuna ukuba uthethe inyaniso yale ntliziyo yakho namhlanje. Akukho nqaku lokuthi uphosile okanye wenze kakubi. Ukugula akwanga kwenzeka ngenxa yezinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye noBen akakubeki icala. Masikhuphe lo mthwalo wokuzisola emajukujukwini eentliziyo zenu namhlanje. Awuphosanga nto. Ubenze konke okusemandleni enu ngothando olungapheliyo. Ezinye izinto zenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lwethu, ngaphandle kokuba nabani na enze impazamo. Niyinyaniso, nithandwa nguThixo.

KwiVangeli, abafundi bakaYesu babexabana ngokuba ngubani omkhulu kubo. UYesu, ebona iintliziyo zabo, wathatha umntwana wammisa ecaleni kwakhe. Wathi: 'Lowo uyamkela lo mntwana egameni lam, uyamkela mna.' Apha, uYesu usifundisa ukuba ubukhulu abukho ekubeni ngaphezulu kwabanye, kodwa bukho ekubeni ngumntwana phambi koThixo. UBen wayengumntwana onjalo. Wayengumfana owayengazikhukhumezi, owayephila ngothando, owayephila ngobubele. Wayengumfana owayephila ngoxolo. Wayengumfana owayesoloko ecinga ngabanye, njengaxa wayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange encinci ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, akazange ayikhuphule ngokoqobo, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Wayengumfana onikela ngayo yonke into yakhe. Lo moya wokunika waba yindlela yakhe yokuphila.

Ryan, mfowethu omncane, uBen uyamthanda. Ungalokothi uzive ungedwa. UBen uyaqhubeka ehamba nawe, ekukhathalele, kwaye uthando lwenu aluzange lufe. Vumela uYesu abe lulwalwa lwakho namhlanje. Thatha igama likaBen, thandaza kuye uThixo, kwaye uqhubeke uphila ngesibindi, wazi ukuba akukho lizwi linye lothando olulahlekileyo phambi koThixo. UBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya ngomsebenzi wakhe wothando, njengaloo mthombo wamanzi eCà Mau, olethela ubomi kwabanye. Uthando lwakhe aluzange luphele; lusaqhubeka lukhanya njengolwandle olukhulu.

Nani, Alan noThao, ningayeki ukuthanda. Nithandeke kakhulu nguThixo. UBen wayengumfana onikela ngayo yonke into yakhe. Nani, nikani konke usizi lwenu kuThixo. Musani ukuzama ukuluthwala lodwa. Vumelani uYesu ukuba abe lulwalwa lwenu. Xa uziva usizi, yithi: 'Nkosi, ndiyakuthanda, kwaye ndiyakuthemba.' UBen uyaqhubeka esidumisela kuThixo. Uthando lwenu luyaqhubeka luhleli, lusaqhubeka lukhula, kwaye uBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya. Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Uthando lwakho lulukhanya olungasoze lwavaleleka. Uthando lwakho, njengaloo mthombo wamanzi, luyaqhubeka luhleli, lusaqhubeka lukhula, kwaye luyaqhubeka lukhanyisa iindlela zethu. Khumbula ukuba uBen uyaqhubeka esidumisela kuThixo, kwaye nathi, simele siphile ngaloo ndlela—ngothando olungagciniyo, ngoxolelo olungapheliyo, nangokholo olomeleleyo. Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu, ndiyakholelwa ukuba ukhona ngenene kwiSakramente eNgcwele ye-Altar. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwako konke, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ngoku ndingenako ukukwamkela ngokwenyama, nceda uze kum ngomoya entliziyweni yam. Ndiyakwamkela njengokungathi sele ulapha, kwaye ndizibophelela ngokupheleleyo kuwe. Ungaze uvumele ukuba ndahlulwe nawe. Amen.
closing: Ngamana uThixo onamandla angakusikelela, akugcine, kwaye akunike uxolo lwakhe olungapheliyo. Hamba ngoxolo.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBenjamin kunye nabo bonke abasishiyeyo, ukuba baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKristu.
Sithandazela bonke abazilileyo, ukuba uThixo abathuthuzele kwaye abanike ithemba.

readings.label: Incwadi kaYobhi
readings.text: Ngenye imini, xa iingelosi zikaThixo zafikayo ukuzimela phambi kweNkosi, uSathana naye wafika phakathi kwazo. INkosi yathi kuSathana, 'Uvela phi?' USathana waphendula iNkosi wathi, 'Ndiyajikeleza emhlabeni ndiwuhambahamba.' INkosi yathi kuSathana, 'Uqaphele umkhonzi wam uYobhi, ukuba akukho mntu unjengaye emhlabeni, ongenatyala nothe tye, owoyika uThixo, aze aphephe okubi?' USathana waphendula iNkosi wathi, 'Ngaba uYobhi uwoyika uThixo ngelize? Awumjikelezanga na wena, nentsapho yakhe, nento yonke anayo, ngokhuseleko lwakho? Ubusikelele umsebenzi wezandla zakhe, nemfuyo yakhe inabile elizweni. Kodwa ngoku yisa isandla sakho, uchukumise nantoni na anayo, uya kukuthuka ebusweni bakho.' INkosi yathi kuSathana, 'Nanku, konke anako kusemandleni akho; kodwa isandla sakho musa ukusibeka phezu kwakhe.' Waphuma ke uSathana phambi kweNkosi. Ngenye imini, ngoxa oonyana bakhe neentombi zakhe babesitya besela iwayini endlwini yomkhulu wabo, kwafika isigidimi kuYobhi sathi, 'Iinkomo zazingalima, neesile ziklabha ecaleni kwazo, kwaza kwafika amaSaba, azithimba. Bababulala abalusi ngekrele, ndasinda mna ndedwa ukuba ndize kukuxelela.' Ngoxa wayesathetha, kwafika omnye wathi, 'Umbane uwile ezulwini, watshisa iimvu nabalusi, wabatshabalalisa; ndasinda mna ndedwa ukuba ndize kukuxelela.' Ngoxa wayesathetha, kwafika omnye isigidimi wathi, 'AmaKaledi enze imiqolo emithathu, azithimba iinkamela, azithatha, ababulala ababelusi ngekrele; ndasinda mna ndedwa ukuba ndize kukuxelela.' Ngoxa wayesathetha, kwafika omnye wathi, 'Oonyana bakho neentombi zakho babesitya besela iwayini endlwini yomkhulu wabo, kwaza kwavela umoya omkhulu entlango, wabetha iikona ezine zendlu. Yawa phezu kwabantwana, bafa; ndasinda mna ndedwa ukuba ndize kukuxelela.' Waza uYobhi wakrazula ingubo yakhe, wacheba intloko yakhe. Wawa phantsi, waqubuda, wathi, 'Ndiyeza ndize ze esizalweni sikamama, ndiya kubuyela ndize ze apho. INkosi yanika, iNkosi yathatha; malibongwe igama leNkosi!' Kuko konke oku, uYobhi akonanga, akathetha nento engahloniphiyo ngoThixo.

readings.label: INdumiso
readings.text: R. Thobela indlebe yakho kum, Nkosi, uve ilizwi lam. Yiva, Nkosi, isicelo esilungileyo; mamela ukukhala kwam; thobela umthandazo wam ovela emilebeni engenakukhohlisa. R. Thobela indlebe yakho kum, Nkosi, uve ilizwi lam. Kuwe makuphele isigwebo sam; amehlo akho abona okulungileyo. Nangona uvavanya intliziyo yam, uyiphengulula ebusuku, nangona undilinga ngomlilo, awuyi kufumana bubi kum. R. Thobela indlebe yakho kum, Nkosi, uve ilizwi lam. Ndibiza kuwe, kuba uya kundiphendula, Thixo; thobela indlebe yakho kum; yiva ilizwi lam. Bonisa imfesane yakho emangalisayo, O msindisi wabo babaleka iintshaba zabo ukuya kufuna indawo yokukhuseleka ngasekunene kwakho. R. Thobela indlebe yakho kum, Nkosi, uve ilizwi lam.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Kwavela impikiswano phakathi kwabafundi malunga nokuba ngubani na omkhulu kubo. UYesu waqonda injongo yeentliziyo zabo, wathatha umntwana wammisa ecaleni kwakhe, wathi kubo, 'Lowo uyamkela lo mntwana egameni lam, uyamkela mna, kwaye lowo undamkelayo mna, uyamkela lowo undithumileyo. Kuba lowo ungomncinci phakathi kwenu nonke, nguye omkhulu.' Waza uYohane waphendula wathi, 'Nkosi, sibone umntu ekhupha iidemon egameni lakho, saza sazama ukumthintela kuba engalandeli nathi.' UYesu wathi kuye, 'Musani ukumthintela, kuba lowo ungenachasene nani, ungakwicala lenu.'

day: Monday of the Twenty-sixth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
